components.css: .ds-pipe{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin:0;padding:12px 0;list-style:none;font-family:"Anuphan", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#15171a)}.ds-pipe::before,.ds-pipe::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:6px;right:calc(25% - 6px);top:18px;height:2px;border-radius:2px}.ds-pipe::before{background:var(--rule,#d8dbd4)}.ds-pipe::after{background:var(--ink,#15171a);right:auto;width:calc((100% - 25% - 6px) * var(--p));transition:width .12s linear}.ds-step{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.ds-dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper,#f5f6f3);border:2px solid var(--rule,#d8dbd4);transition:background-color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease}.ds-sn{margin-top:8px;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2}.ds-ss{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-3,#6b7079);line-height:1.35;margin-top:2px}.ds-step.done .ds-dot{background:var(--ink,#15171a);border-color:var(--ink,#15171a)}.ds-step.now .ds-dot{background:var(--mark,#d4f53c);border-color:var(--ink,#15171a);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--mark-soft,#eefab8)}.ds-step.now .ds-sn{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The page behaves like a requirements document someone has read carefully with a highlighter in hand. Cool off-white paper, near-black ink, hairline rules between rows, and exactly one loud colour: an acid-lime marker that lands on the few words and states that matter right now. Nothing floats, nothing glows, nothing is boxed into cards; structure comes from rules, columns and type weight.

Density is calm and editorial. Thai and Latin share one family (Anuphan) at generous line height, so both scripts sit in the same rhythm and Thai stacked vowels never collide. On desktop a sticky left column holds identity, navigation and the email action while content scrolls past on the right; on phones the same content stacks under a slim sticky bar that carries the language switch. The signature motion is a four-stage pipeline (Requirement, Spec, Build, Test) that fills in ink as the reader scrolls through the work it describes.

The system refuses the dark neon developer portfolio and the cream résumé: no dark ground, no glow, no gradient text, no warm parchment.
keyCharacteristics: One cool-paper ground, one near-black ink, one acid-lime marker; greys are cool ink tints, not neutrals of their own.
Hairline rules (1px) are the only structural device; media frames are the only bordered rectangles.
Pills for things you press or that carry state; soft 10px corners for images; everything else square.
A single variable family (Anuphan, 100–700) for both scripts, weight doing the hierarchy work.
Motion is short, eased and tied to reading position; it disappears completely under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Lime appears only where the reader's attention should land now: at most the role line, the contact email, and the single current pipeline step and chip. If two things on screen are lime and neither is "current", one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Same-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Sticky layers (top bar, pipeline bar, sidebar) use the paper colour plus a hairline, never a tint, blur or shadow. Depth is implied by the rule, not by material.

rules.name: The Tall Line Rule
rules.body: Body copy keeps line-height at 1.7 or more. Thai above-and-below marks need the room; tightening body leading to Latin-only defaults breaks the Thai page first.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface, no monospace for "code-ness", no system display face. Emphasis is weight, the marker, or an underline.

rules.name: The Rows-Not-Cards Rule
rules.body: Collections (work, projects, skills, certificates) are rows divided by 1px hairlines, never grids of boxed cards.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the page. A new surface that "needs" a shadow needs a hairline instead.

dos: **Do** keep the page on Cool Paper with Graphite Ink text and let hairline rules (1px Hairline) carry all structure.
**Do** reserve Acid-Lime Marker for the role line, the contact email and the single current pipeline state, per The One Marker Rule.
**Do** keep body line-height at 1.7–1.75 and measures at 60–62ch so Thai and English read in the same rhythm.
**Do** use pills (999px) for pressable or stateful controls and 10px corners only on image frames.
**Do** make every sticky layer paper plus a bottom hairline.
**Do** ship every string in both Thai and English from the same table, and keep 32px minimum hit areas on secondary controls and 48px on the primary button.
**Do** honour reduced motion by removing transitions, not by swapping in alternatives.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, blurred glows or lifted cards; the only ring in the system is the current pipeline step's.
**Don't** fill text with gradients or use soft multi-stop gradients as decoration; gradients exist only as hard-stop marker bands and the one functional paper scrim.
**Don't** introduce a dark ground, neon accents or a second accent colour.
**Don't** box collections into card grids; use hairline-divided rows.
**Don't** add a second typeface, a monospace "dev" face or a system display face.
**Don't** set Pencil Grey text on Shaded Paper or use Hairline as a text colour.
